title: Project Requirements
body:
1. Choose a task
    You are free to pick anything compatible with the course (i.e. text classification/regression, or sequence prediction/labelling, sequence-to-sequence), but we list some options to inspire you along with dataset suggestions on the tasks suggestions page.

  2. Use deep learning architectures
    All of your solutions must employ NN architectures to parameterise statistical models. Use stochastic optimisation powered by backpropagation to estimate parameters for your model via the maximum likelihood principle (or a relevant approximation of it) or by minimising an appropriate loss for the task.

 



insufficient

sufficient

(very) good

excellent

writing

Text is poorly written, many details lacking, lacking insights, and poor presentation of method/experiments. The text does not follow the provided template.

Text is decently written, but with some errors and typos. Method and experiment parts not always in logical order.

Text is clearly written and visualised, with minor issues. Method and experiments explained with appropriate visualisations.

Text is well written with only few mistakes. Clear explanation of method and clear structuring of experiments with great visualisations . Interesting lessons learned from the paper.

knowledge and placement of work

There is some discussion of related work and background, but the description shows serious errors and/or limitations

Relevant background is used, but the description shows occasional errors or is incomplete, lacking focus in the literature review.

Relevant background is used, is nicely synthesized, and is successfully tailored to the research at hand.

Clear, and relevant background with exciting insights into limitations of earlier work.

methodology

The model is not new, but a reimplementation and it does not offer any new insights.

The model is a variation of an existing model. For example, an existing model applied to a new domain.

Choice of modeling elements are motivated by a good understanding of the task and potentially an ablation study.

Modeling approach provides insights that are meaningful to the field.

analysis

The analysis is not insightful and / or trivial.

The analysis demonstrates a good understanding of the experimental setup and data, but lacks original elements.

The analysis is original and might inspire further research.

The analysis is advanced and original. Points to actionable future directions.

technical skills

Able to modify an existing tool or model, but errors occur and persist. No validation.

Able to make minor modifications to an existing tool or model. Superficial validation.

Able to make major modifications to an existing tool or model, based on literature. Validation using some basic measures of quality.

Able to make major modifications to an existing tool or model and  organize the data, perform thorough checks.
